inputs.name: allowed_vpc_endpoint_ids
inputs.description: When set, every request must arrive through one of these VPC endpoints. Makes the bucket unreachable from the internet even with valid credentials

inputs.name: block_public_access
inputs.description: Block all forms of public access. Leave true and serve public content through CloudFront

inputs.name: bucket_key_enabled
inputs.description: Enable S3 Bucket Keys with SSE-KMS, which cuts KMS request costs on read-heavy buckets

inputs.name: bucket_name
inputs.description: Name of the bucket. Must be globally unique

inputs.name: cloudfront_distribution_arn
inputs.description: ARN of a CloudFront distribution granted read access through Origin Access Control

inputs.name: cors_rules
inputs.type:
list(object({
    allowed_methods = list(string)
    allowed_origins = list(string)
    allowed_headers = optional(list(string))
    expose_headers  = optional(list(string))
    max_age_seconds = optional(number)
  }))
inputs.description: CORS rules, needed when a browser calls the bucket directly

inputs.name: force_destroy
inputs.description: Allow destroying a bucket that still contains objects. Keep false for anything holding real data

inputs.name: kms_key_arn
inputs.description: KMS key ARN for SSE-KMS. When null, SSE-S3 (AES256) is used

inputs.name: lambda_notifications
inputs.description: Event notifications to Lambda functions, keyed by notification id

inputs.name: lifecycle_rules
inputs.description:
Lifecycle rules. Each entry supports:
  - id (required) and enabled (optional, true)
  - prefix (optional): scope the rule to a key prefix
  - transitions / noncurrent_version_transitions: lists of
    { days, storage_class }
  - expiration_days / noncurrent_version_expiration_days
  - abort_incomplete_multipart_upload_days: cleans up failed uploads,
    which are billed but invisible in the console

inputs.name: logging_target_bucket
inputs.description: Bucket receiving access logs. Must be a different bucket

inputs.name: logging_target_prefix
inputs.description: Prefix for the access logs (defaults to <bucket_name>/)

inputs.name: object_lock_mode
inputs.description: Object Lock retention mode: GOVERNANCE, COMPLIANCE, or null to disable. Can only be set when the bucket is created

inputs.name: object_lock_retention_days
inputs.description: Default retention period in days when Object Lock is enabled

inputs.name: object_ownership
inputs.description: Object ownership: BucketOwnerEnforced disables ACLs entirely (recommended)

inputs.name: policy_statements
inputs.description: Additional bucket policy statements

inputs.name: replication_role_name
inputs.description: Name of the replication IAM role (defaults to <bucket_name>-replication)

inputs.name: replication_rules
inputs.type:
list(object({
    id                        = string
    destination_bucket_arn    = string
    enabled                   = optional(bool, true)
    prefix                    = optional(string)
    destination_storage_class = optional(string, "STANDARD")
    destination_kms_key_arn   = optional(string)
    destination_account_id    = optional(string)
    replication_time_minutes  = optional(number)
    replicate_delete_markers  = optional(bool, false)
  }))
inputs.description:
Cross-region (or cross-account) replication rules. Requires versioning on
both source and destination buckets. Each entry supports:
  - id (required) and enabled (optional, true)
  - destination_bucket_arn (required)
  - prefix (optional): replicate only this key prefix
  - destination_storage_class (optional, STANDARD)
  - destination_kms_key_arn (optional): key for the replica
  - destination_account_id (optional): cross-account destination; sets
    ownership override so the destination account owns the replicas
  - replication_time_minutes (optional): enables S3 Replication Time
    Control with this SLA, which is billed extra
  - replicate_delete_markers (optional, false)

inputs.name: sns_notifications
inputs.description: Event notifications to SNS topics, keyed by notification id

inputs.name: sqs_notifications
inputs.description: Event notifications to SQS queues, keyed by notification id

inputs.name: tags
inputs.description: Tags applied to the bucket

inputs.name: versioning_enabled
inputs.description: Enable object versioning, which protects against overwrites and deletions. Required for replication and Object Lock

inputs.name: website_enabled
inputs.description: Enable the S3 website endpoint. HTTP only, no TLS: prefer CloudFront with OAC for production sites

inputs.name: website_error_document
inputs.description: Error document for the website endpoint

inputs.name: website_index_document
inputs.description: Index document for the website endpoint

outputs.name: bucket_domain_name
outputs.description: Global domain name of the bucket

outputs.name: bucket_regional_domain_name
outputs.description: Regional domain name, used as the CloudFront origin

outputs.name: hosted_zone_id
outputs.description: Route53 hosted zone ID of the bucket's region

outputs.name: replication_role_arn
outputs.description: ARN of the replication role (null when replication is not configured)

outputs.name: website_domain
outputs.description: Domain of the website endpoint, for Route53 alias records

outputs.name: website_endpoint
outputs.description: S3 website endpoint (null when the website configuration is disabled)
